request.description: Set newVendorPhone to an unused 10-digit number.
Set customerPhone in collection variables to a new 10-digit number for a fresh signup. In dev mode the OTP is 1234.

item.name: 2. Verify OTP (no name -> 400 for new users)

exec: pm.test("new user must give a name (400) / existing user logs in (200)", () => pm.expect([200, 400]).to.include(pm.response.code)); const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.accessToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set("customerToken", b.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set("customerRefresh", b.refreshToken); }
const b = pm.response.json(); if (pm.response.code < 300 && b.id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set("addressId", b.id);

const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set("orderId", b.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("pickupOtp", b.otps.pickup); pm.collectionVariables.set("deliveryOtp", b.otps.delivery); } console.log("order", b.orderNumber, "pickup OTP", b.otps && b.otps.pickup, "delivery OTP", b.otps && b.otps.delivery);

item.name: 7. Place order (WALLET, expect 422 if balance low)

request.description: Only run this if you want to cancel; otherwise continue to the rider flow.

body.raw:
{
  "subject": "Shirt button missing after wash",

  "category": "DAMAGE",
  "priority": "HIGH",
  "orderId": "{{orderId}}"
}

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (pm.response.code < 300 && b.id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set("ticketId", b.id);

const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.otps) { pm.collectionVariables.set("vendorDropOtp", b.otps.riderDrop); pm.collectionVariables.set("vendorHandoverOtp", b.otps.riderHandover); console.log("drop OTP", b.otps.riderDrop, "handover OTP", b.otps.riderHandover); }

request.description: Set newRiderPhone to an unused number.

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.data && b.data.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("requestId", b.data[0].requestId); console.log("offer", b.data[0].leg, b.data[0].orderNumber, "remaining", b.data[0].remainingSeconds); }

item.name: 12. Confirm drop-off at vendor (vendor drop OTP)

request.description: vendorDropOtp is filled by Vendor -> 3. Order detail.

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.data && b.data.length) pm.collectionVariables.set("verificationId", b.data[0].id);
const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.data && b.data.length) pm.collectionVariables.set("payoutId", b.data[0].id);
const d = new Date(Date.now() + 86400000); pm.collectionVariables.set('tomorrow', d.toISOString().slice(0,10));
